description: Verify the agent produces an Eloquent macro apiQuery() call with allowed filters and sorting
prompt: Create an API controller method index() for the Product model in Laravel that allows filtering by name and status, searching across name and sku, and sorting by price or created_at.

description: Verify the agent correctly configures relational filter and eager loading without N+1
prompt: We have an Author model that has many Books. Build the API endpoint to list authors, allowing the client to filter by books.title, eager load books and comments, and count reviews.

description: Verify the agent uses defaultFilters() instead of mutating the base builder
prompt: In our UserController, we want the default status to be 'active' if the client doesn't send any filter, but allow the user to filter by inactive or banned.

description: Verify the agent refuses or avoids sorting on relations
prompt: Allow sorting by the user's role name in the index controller using ApiQueryBuilder.
